text: SELECT "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers".customer_id AS customer_id, "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers".customer_name AS customer_name, COUNT(DISTINCT "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders".order_id) AS order_count FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders" JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers" ON "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders".customer_id = "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers".customer_id GROUP BY "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers".customer_id, "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers".customer_name ORDER BY order_count DESC LIMIT 500
